decisions.participationOmitted: customerParticipants.own() rows carry no workspaceId and no update time, so they cannot be scoped to the person's workspaces or dated without a join by programme id. The adapter lists no participation items; the Delegations link is unchanged. Raised to the Conductor.
decisions.requestsHaveNoTitle: private_requests rows carry no title or update time. Request items use title null and updatedAt = createdAt; the original brief is read only for its objective and never copied into a row.
decisions.programmesHaveNoStatus: A programme has no status of its own, so its item status is empty and updatedAt = createdAt.
decisions.detailReadsBounded: At most 30 request details are read per list (workDetailCap); later requests are UNCLASSIFIED, listed, and not marked unreadable.
